craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 2. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Of their higher-śāstra-told mantras: not installed; should put outside
, then: these, by secrecy, are givers of siddhi.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ
